summary: R222 makes sampled ExactSamples fail closed on the actual D3DCompile result for each tracked fixed-function shader signature. Successful compile signatures are cached by the existing sampled signature hash, repeated signatures reuse only cached success, compile failures/hash-cap skips remain non-exact, and a concurrent repeat observed before the first probe completes is deliberately non-exact. NativeDrawPath remains dormant.

C0_RECOVER.evidence: Recovered authenticated vr-dx11-native-r71 HEAD a4271f8ab2473036ffc508f238b411501c45d753; read AGENTS.md, VR_BACKEND_100_REVIEW_INDEX.md/Set05, QUEUE_CONTROLLER_CONTRACT.md, CONVERSION_LANE_STATE.json, VR_AUTODEV_STATE.json, VR_RUN_STATE.md, VR_REGRESSION_KNOWLEDGE.json, VR_PROBLEM_HISTORY.md and Issue #14. R221/00315 is durable and was not repeated.

C1_REVIEW.finding: R221 guarantees bounded compile-probe coverage for newly tracked fixed-function signatures, but the per-sample ExactSamples boundary still depends on source-generation/shader-readiness flags and does not consume the actual compileProbe.succeeded result. A generated ps_4_0 source that fails D3DCompile can therefore still satisfy the sampled exactness gate.

review_lenses.architecture: Reuse the existing signature identity and compile probe; add only a successful-compile cache and a final fail-closed gate. No native draw ownership change.
review_lenses.ownership_lifetime: The cache is process-local diagnostic state guarded by the existing SignatureMutex; no COM/resource/reset/device-generation ownership changes.
review_lenses.stereo_correctness: No WVP, eye routing, HUD, surface, OpenXR or presentation behavior changes.
review_lenses.performance: No repeat compilation is added. Existing unique-signature probes remain bounded by SignatureHashCap=512; repeated signatures only perform a guarded set lookup.
review_lenses.adversarial: Compile failure, hash-cap overflow, missing prototype, and a racing repeat before first-probe completion all remain non-exact.

C2_IMPLEMENT.evidence: Changed note_signature to return per-signature compile readiness, cached only successful fixed-function compile hashes under SignatureMutex, reused cached success for repeats, and added shaderCompileReadinessExact to the final ExactSamples condition. Static source-graph and dormant-activation contracts were extended for R222.

C3_VALIDATE.evidence: Material commit must be published without CI-skip; exact-SHA Backend Conversion Gate is required.

C5_PACKAGE.reason: Dormant census/readiness evidence only; no runtime candidate or package identity changes.

C6_STATE.exact_next_action: After exact-SHA Backend Conversion Gate PASS, persist validation IDs and lane state in a separate CI-skipped bookkeeping commit while preserving the material validation-bearing SHA.

regression_assessment.evidence: R222 changes only src/vr/d3d11/runtime_census.cpp diagnostic readiness accounting and static verifiers. It does not touch the recorded D3D9 startup/HUD/world-stereo risk paths, native draw routing, Reset/Present, transport/shared resources, or OpenXR submission.

exact_next_action: Require the exact-SHA Backend Conversion Gate for the published R222 result. Do not treat hosted validation as Quest 3/VDXR runtime proof.
